limits: These are behavioral simulations against actual frontend functions, not live Odoo or Meta template sends.
Odoo method availability, template delivery, channel field permissions and database custom defaults still require authorized live validation.
Temporary customer linkage is in this app instance only when Odoo rejects or lacks an editable relation.
Every app opening still explicitly requests global manual mode, as required; another device opening can turn the shared mode off.
Browser automatic scanners are disabled; backend/Zapier processing, durable AI memory and live handover behavior were not end-to-end tested.
No exactly-once guarantee is claimed after a user manually retries an uncertain send.
